source: Pins the shape of interface AvailabilityEntry from @kiosinc/commons-types types/availabilityTypes.ts (kiosinc/kios-commons-types#74) as declared in src/domain/services/AvailabilityEntryService.ts. updatedAt is the Admin SDK Timestamp here (FirestoreTimestampLike in commons-types). Contract: kiosinc/restaurant-core-claude#162 §1 as amended 2026-09-03. A contract change lands in commons-types, the rcc declaration, and this snapshot together. PENDING 2026-09-10 (rcc#221): the third kind 'optionSet' has NOT shipped in the @kiosinc/commons-types mirror yet — this snapshot and the rcc declaration lead it, and widening the commons-types union is a tracked follow-up of rcc#221.
